changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: MrScruff's Kit A/B, ported to elemod by Iced-Cream, with his code unchanged.
NO + PLAY and the KIT menu RELOAD toggle between the kit as edited and as saved: the first press stashes the edits (KIT 1 RELOADED!), the next restores them (EDITS RESTORED!).
Editing while the original plays, changing kit or any other reload ends the A/B; a press on a kit with no edits is a plain reload.
One set of edits is kept, 2.5 KB from the firmware's heap taken on the first press.
